name: Tailscale auto-connect on Mini boot
pitch: Make the Mini rejoin the tailnet by itself after a reboot, so any reboot is remotely recoverable — today a reboot can strand SSH.
notes: Confirmed 2026-06-25: the Mini runs the GUI App Store Tailscale (/Applications/Tailscale.app), NOT a boot daemon — it only connects inside the logged-in GUI session, so a reboot can come back with Tailscale DOWN and lock out SSH until someone is physically at the Mini. Fix: (1) run boot-time tailscaled independent of GUI login; (2) disable key expiry for the Mini node in the admin console; (3) PROVE via an SSH-reboot test before trusting it. De-risks every reboot; HARD PREREQ before any guarded chat.db auto-reboot. Todoist task 6gxW9gJJCWhCQMpq (p2).
